install.notes: The package is served on the fake backend without installing anything. The upstream clone is a labscript user-device package (README.rst:22-26); the hardware path imports labscript_devices, blacs and zprocess, loads numpy, and needs the proprietary Andor SDK3 DLL (atmcd64d.dll/atmcd32d.dll) on Windows (AndorSolis/andor_sdk/andor_solis.py:21-44). The gate never imports native.py or the upstream package.
